title: UAP IP document (one file under ips/ describes exactly one IP)
description: An IP is an independent asset, decoupled from EU research projects. Its Owners are organizations from cfg/partners.json; project-related work lives in per-project Task files under projects/.

Id.description: Slug identifier; should match the file name under ips/.

Owners.description: Organizations owning this IP (references into cfg/partners.json, matched by name or alias; 'TBD' allowed until owners are assigned). At least one entry required.

URL.description: Canonical repository/asset URL; empty when unknown.

Category.description: One or more category names from cfg/categories.json (matched by name or alias).
